about: Made-up exchanges between a person and SYNTHIA, with the lasting facts a reader would take from each, written before any extraction was run. Also facts that change, and pairs of statements that are or are not the same fact. No real person's data.

exchanges.person: My cat is called Miso and she hates the vacuum cleaner.
exchanges.synthia: Miso sounds like a character. Plenty of cats dislike the vacuum's noise.
expected: The person's cat is called Miso.
Miso hates the vacuum cleaner.

exchanges.person: I'm allergic to peanuts, so keep that in mind for any recipes.
exchanges.synthia: Noted. I'll leave peanuts out of every recipe I suggest.
expected: The person is allergic to peanuts.

exchanges.person: What's the capital of Australia?
exchanges.synthia: Canberra.

exchanges.person: Can you convert 5 miles to kilometres?
exchanges.synthia: 5 miles is about 8.05 kilometres.

exchanges.person: My sister Ananya lives in Pune and works as an architect.
exchanges.synthia: An architect in Pune, there is a lot being built there.
expected: The person's sister is called Ananya.
Ananya lives in Pune.
Ananya works as an architect.

exchanges.person: I prefer short answers, no long explanations unless I ask.
exchanges.synthia: Understood, I'll keep it short.
expected: The person prefers short answers.

exchanges.person: Write a haiku about the monsoon.
exchanges.synthia: Grey clouds lean closer / the street becomes a river / chai steam on the glass

exchanges.person: I start my new job at Infosys on Monday, as a data engineer.
exchanges.synthia: Congratulations on the new role! Good luck on Monday.
expected: The person is starting a new job at Infosys as a data engineer.

exchanges.person: I'm vegetarian, but I eat eggs.
exchanges.synthia: Got it: vegetarian, eggs are fine.
expected: The person is vegetarian but eats eggs.

exchanges.person: Remind me how to undo the last git commit.
exchanges.synthia: git reset --soft HEAD~1 keeps the changes staged.

exchanges.person: I run 5 km every morning before work.
exchanges.synthia: That's a great habit.
expected: The person runs 5 km every morning before work.

exchanges.person: My daughter Riya turns six in March.
exchanges.synthia: Six is a fun age. Any party plans?
expected: The person's daughter is called Riya.
Riya turns six in March.

exchanges.person: Ugh, traffic was terrible today.
exchanges.synthia: Sorry to hear that. Long drive?

exchanges.person: I use Neovim for everything, VS Code feels too heavy to me.
exchanges.synthia: Neovim it is. I'll give editor tips for it.
expected: The person uses Neovim and finds VS Code too heavy.

exchanges.person: Explain how a heat pump works.
exchanges.synthia: It moves heat with a refrigerant cycle instead of making it.

exchanges.person: We're planning a trip to Ladakh in July.
exchanges.synthia: July is a good month for Ladakh, the passes are open.
expected: The person is planning a trip to Ladakh in July.

exchanges.person: My manager is Priya, she runs the platform team.
exchanges.synthia: Noted, Priya leads the platform team.
expected: The person's manager is Priya.
Priya runs the platform team.

exchanges.person: Please always answer in British English spelling.
exchanges.synthia: Will do, colour and all.
expected: The person wants answers in British English spelling.

exchanges.person: Thanks, that worked!
exchanges.synthia: Glad it helped.

exchanges.person: I don't drink coffee, only green tea.
exchanges.synthia: Green tea it is. Any favourite kind?
expected: The person drinks only green tea, not coffee.

exchanges.person: Is it going to rain in Bangalore tomorrow?
exchanges.synthia: I can't see the forecast, but the season is wet.

exchanges.person: I live in Bangalore, in Indiranagar.
exchanges.synthia: Indiranagar is a lively area.
expected: The person lives in Indiranagar, Bangalore.

exchanges.person: My laptop is a ThinkPad X1 Carbon with 32 GB of RAM.
exchanges.synthia: That's plenty for local development.
expected: The person's laptop is a ThinkPad X1 Carbon with 32 GB of RAM.

exchanges.person: What did Einstein win the Nobel prize for?
exchanges.synthia: The photoelectric effect, in 1921.

changes.known: The person's sister Ananya lives in Pune.
changes.person: Ananya moved to Mumbai last month.
changes.synthia: A big move! Mumbai will keep her busy.

changes.known: The person works at Infosys as a data engineer.
changes.person: I left Infosys, I'm at Swiggy now on their data team.
changes.synthia: Congrats on the switch to Swiggy.
changes.expected: The person works on the data team at Swiggy.

changes.known: The person is vegetarian but eats eggs.
changes.person: I've gone fully vegan since January.
changes.synthia: Vegan noted, no eggs or dairy then.

changes.known: The person runs 5 km every morning before work.
changes.person: I switched from morning runs to evening swims.
changes.synthia: Swimming is easy on the knees.
changes.expected: The person swims in the evening instead of running in the morning.

changes.known: The person uses Neovim for everything.
changes.person: I've moved to Helix, Neovim config was too much work.

changes.known: The person lives in Indiranagar, Bangalore.
changes.person: We moved to Whitefield last week.
changes.expected: The person lives in Whitefield, Bangalore.

changes.person: Priya left, my new manager is Karthik.

changes.known: The person drinks only green tea.
changes.person: I've started drinking coffee again, one cup a day.
changes.synthia: One cup is a moderate amount.
changes.expected: The person drinks one cup of coffee a day.
